title: Spanish (European)

personNotes.tú: you, one person you know well

tutor: European Spanish as spoken in Spain (use vosotros where relevant, and Spain vocabulary like "vale")

roadmap.title: What happened yesterday
roadmap.can: Tell a story about yesterday or last year with the pretérito indefinido: fui, comí, vi

roadmap.title: When I was little
roadmap.can: Describe how things used to be with the imperfecto: vivía, era, había

roadmap.title: What's coming
roadmap.can: Talk about the future and make promises: iré, haré, vendré

roadmap.title: Wishes and advice
roadmap.can: Give advice and say what you hope for with the subjuntivo: quiero que vengas
